series.name: GS Series UPS
series.notes: Wayback gsseries.html: label-level LED/LCD + named alarms; no blink periods published (medium).

meaning.en: LED panel includes "Fault conditions" (alongside Utility, Battery, Inverter, Over Load, Load/battery level) — no sub-patterns published
meaning.ur: LED panel mein "Fault conditions" bhi shamil hai (Utility, Battery, Inverter, Over Load, Load/battery level ke saath) - koi sub-pattern publish nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: Overload, battery or mains problem reported together
causes.ur: Load, battery ya mains ka masla saath saath aa raha hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking any wiring on the UPS.
solutions.ur: UPS ki koi bhi wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Note which other LEDs — Utility, Battery, Inverter, Over Load — stay lit with Fault; that points to the real problem.
solutions.ur: Fault ke saath kaun se doosre LEDs — Utility, Battery, Inverter, Over Load — jal rahe hain note karein; isi se asal masla pata chalta hai.

solutions.en: Check load, battery and input supply; if nothing obvious is found the UPS goes to a service centre because no sub-codes are published.
solutions.ur: Load, battery aur input supply check karein; kuch samajh na aaye to UPS service centre le jayein kyunke koi sub-code publish nahi hua.

meaning.en: LCD includes a Fault item (with Input/Output V, frequency, load %, temp, battery V) — no numeric codes
meaning.ur: LCD main fault aaitm — number code nahin

causes.en: Input or output outside limits, or internal board fault
causes.ur: Input ya output limits se bahar hai, ya andar board ka fault hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before touching the UPS.
solutions.ur: UPS chunein se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Read the LCD values shown with Fault — input/output volts, frequency, load %, temp, battery volts — and note the abnormal one.
solutions.ur: Fault ke saath LCD ki values padhein — input/output volts, frequency, load %, temp, battery volts — aur jo ghalat ho use note karein.

solutions.en: Correct what is out of range (mains, battery, load); if the Fault item stays, a service centre is required.
solutions.ur: Jo limit se bahar hai (mains, battery, load) theek karein; Fault item bani rahe to service centre zaroori.

notes.ur: Sirf label par diya gaya hai

meaning.ur: line fyl aur aylarm bajta hai

solutions.ur: Input supply ya generator check karein

notes.ur: Sirf naam wale conditions hain, blink pattern nahi

causes.ur: Battery kamzor ya discharge ho gayi

solutions.ur: Battery charge karein aur test karein

meaning.ur: Yeh naam diya gaya alarm: "Transfer to Bypass"

causes.en: overload (GS thresholds: 105–120% → bypass after 15 min; 120–150% → 30 s; >150% immediate) or other protection
causes.ur: Load zyada (GS thresholds: 105–120% → 15 min baad bypass; 120–150% → 30 s; >150% foran) ya koi doosri protection

causes.en: Load kept above the UPS rating for this model
causes.ur: Is model ki rating se zyada load laga hua hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the connected load.
solutions.ur: Laga hua load check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Reduce load below the UPS rating — GS shifts to bypass at 105–120% after 15 min, at 120–150% after 30 s and immediately above 150%.
solutions.ur: Load UPS rating se kam karein — GS 105–120% par 15 minute baad, 120–150% par 30 second baad aur 150% se upar foran bypass par chala jata hai.

solutions.en: After removing the extra load, power cycle once and confirm the UPS leaves bypass; if it returns, a technician checks the bypass relay.
solutions.ur: Extra load hata kar ek baar power cycle karein aur confirm karein ke UPS bypass se nikal gaya; wapas aaye to technician bypass relay check kare.

notes.en: thresholds from same page's overload table
notes.ur: Yehi page ke overload table se thresholds liye gaye hain

causes.en: Internal board or protection component failed
causes.ur: Andar ka board ya protection component fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and remove the load and battery before any inspection.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi check se pehle power off karein, AC ko isolate karein aur load aur battery hata dein.

solutions.en: With the supply isolated, look and smell for burn marks, loose connectors or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke dekhein aur smell karein — jale hue nishan, dhile connectors ya phata hua fuse to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the alarm sounds again after a single power cycle, send the UPS to a service centre — no sub-codes are published.
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle ke baad alarm phir baje to UPS ko service centre bhejein — koi sub-code publish nahi hua.
